data.title: Rejection of application for medical rehabilitation
data.summary: The Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn (statutory pension insurance) rejected Johanna Beispielacker's application for inpatient medical rehabilitation, finding that outpatient physiotherapy is sufficient. The decision is dated 18 November 2026 and was sent on Saturday, 21 November 2026, and can be challenged with an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The pension insurer decided that you do not currently qualify for inpatient rehabilitation because your doctors' records show outpatient physiotherapy is enough. If you disagree, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Rentenversicherung; the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the rejection becomes final. You can also apply again at any time if your symptoms get worse, without needing to object now. Consider getting medical or social-law advice if you plan to object.

key_facts.quote: Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the rejection
items.action: If you disagree with the rejection, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, or have it recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the rejection of your rehabilitation application becomes final and can no longer be challenged through this objection.

items.action: You may submit a new application for rehabilitation at any time if your health problems get worse.
